title: Pure Thunder Dragon
summary: Thunder Dragon cards only, with generic Links and staples. Thunder Dragons are Thunder monsters whose effects activate from the hand by discarding themselves, then trigger again when banished or sent from the field to the GY. Thunder Dragon discards to search two copies of itself, Thunder Dragondark searches another of itself, and Thunder Dragonroar recovers a Thunder Dragon card. Thunder Dragonhawk revives one. Once a Thunder effect has been used in the hand, Thunder Dragon Colossus summons itself by tributing a Thunder monster and stops the opponent from searching. Thunder Dragon Titan, Fusion Summoned or stacked on top, destroys a card every time a Thunder effect activates in the hand. Thunder Dragonlord, the newest card (2020), comes out the same way by banishing a Thunder monster and protects your Thunder monsters on the opponent's turn. Thunder Dragon Fusion shuffles materials back from anywhere to Fusion Summon.
